newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHIS ENTERS RUSSIA IN TWO MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: UHIS ENTERS RUSSIA IN TWO MONTHS.

text.p: Uhispank, the third largest bank in Estonia, will launch its leasing subsidiary in Russia in two months, the bank said on Thursday.
Uhispank said earlier it will sign an agreement with a Russian company next week to launch a leasing firm in St Petersburg.
"Registration takes about a month and hopefully we will be ready to fix all other things in two months," Andrei Happonen, the project leader, told Reuters.
Russia's leasing market is undeveloped compared to Estonia's, he said.
"No active leasing companies can be seen in Russia, especially in St Petersburg," Happonen said.
"Our policy is to start offering services offered by nobody in Russia," he added.
Happonen did not say which portfolios the company is going to hold, because the business plan will be ready only after some days.
If Uhispank activity in St Petersburg will be successful with good economic results, the bank also plans to expand to other areas in Russia, Happonen added.
